race.title: Edwina Jones 80th Birthday Celebrations Novices' Handicap Chase
race.verdict: WANNABE was set to be beaten only by a subsequent winner when departing at the last over C&D on chase bow/return so looks a big player off the same mark. Potential improvers Manhattan Valley and Walk Tall are feared most. WANNABE (IRE) MANHATTAN VALLEY (FR) WALK TALL (IRE)
